name: Gorgonopsid War-Beast
journal_prompt: A shaggy sabre-toothed Permian predator, bred by the Asura long ago as shock cavalry. This one wears an old harness and a new owner's knots, and dozes at the edge of camp.
appearance: A shaggy-haired, sabre-toothed gorgonopsid, heavy in the shoulder, often still wearing a harness from an older use.
